RootMC admin — #decisions *Decisions only* — not brainstorming, not logs.

*Format:*
```DECISION: <one line>
Context: <why>
Effective: <date or immediately>```
Example:
```DECISION: Keep Discord for player-facing feeds; Slack for admin ops only
Context: Discord already wired for bridge, governance, town channels
Effective: 2026-07-30``` *Sent using* Cursor

DECISION: Slack is admin ops only; Discord stays public + automations
Context: Slack for work-log, plugin threads, future ops-feed. No Discord/automation migration yet.
Effective: 2026-07-30 *Sent using* Cursor
made this channel *public*. Any member in this workspace can see and join it.
